- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 45
- Description: Governor direction — SKU component-vs-product discrimination + repoint primitive authorization
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/660
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/661

  Details:
  Governor time on the SKU component-vs-product thread, 2026-11-25 → 2026-11-27. 45 minutes, per Gary Teh's own statement.
  
  WHAT THE 45 MINUTES CONSISTED OF (all direction/correction, no execution)
  
  1. Caught the empty-pouch-as-cacao error. I had treated "Ceremonial Cacao Kraft Pouch - 20250219006" ($0.675) as a cacao lot. Gary's correction: it is an empty kraft pouch — packaging, not product. This was the error that seeded the entire thread.
  
  2. Redirected my column reading. I read col 19 (Price) as col 21 (Manager) and reported "34 rows still at Matheus." Actual count was 1. Gary's challenge forced the column index to be sourced from server/sheets/qr_codes.py instead of inferred.
  
  3. Challenged the unreconciled quantity claim. I asserted "189 does not reconcile with 170" without verifying the basis. The genuine delta is an origin line vs its arrived AWB-suffixed counterpart — the same physical goods at two stages, not two stocks. I had fabricated a discrepancy.
  
  4. Directed the scope: "do all 3" SKU units, then "loop till completed" — which set the PR sequence (classifier, doc, Black King correction, §5j gate).
  
  5. Authorized and sequenced the dao_protocol primitive for --set-qr-manager / --set-qr-currency after I flagged that the 35-row repoint needed a hand-rolled gspread script.
  
  6. Made two explicit scope decisions: leave Currencies!A113 (Matheus 115 / Gary 74) unreconciled as genuine component stock, and (option c) leave both overlapping SKU contribution rows in place rather than correcting the ledger.
  
  GOVERNOR APPROVAL COUNT: 6 PRs approved and merged.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/660
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/661
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1943
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1944
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1945
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dao_protocol/pull/191
  
  NOTE ON THIS THREAD'S LEDGER STATE
  Gary's explicit instruction (option c) is that the two existing SKU contribution rows (330 min + 465 min = 795 min, both [Full Provision Awarded]) are left as-is despite overlapping evidence and a likely duplicate TDG award. Recorded as known-state by governor decision, not an open defect awaiting fix.
  
  No production deploy. No money movement. TDG for this row left to the rubric.

- TDG Issued: 75.00
